1. (Currently amended) A packaging substrate comprising: a packaging structure having a chip mounting surface and a bottom surface, the packaging structure having a plurality of conductive paths formed between the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the conductive paths configured to provide electrical connection between an integrated circuit chip disposed on the chip mounting surface and the bottom surface, the packaging structure having an opening formed in the chip mounting surface proximate a perimeter of the packaging structure, wherein the opening is formed by __removing at least a portion of a solder mask layer to expose an underlying core layer__; and a stiffening microstructure disposed in the opening and coupled to the packaging structure, __wherein the stiffening microstructure is bonded to at least one of a bottom surface or a sidewall of the opening and extends above the chip mounting surface__.
